premises.text: Email is a massive content silo that causes headaches for users
premises.evidence_span: email is a massive content silo, right? Stuff just gets stuck in there.

premises.text: Large amounts of data are moving into email and just sitting there
premises.evidence_span: over 6 billion attachments will be sent by email. Large amounts of data are moving into email and just sitting there.

premises.text: Cloudless allows users to move files directly into other cloud services while keeping them associated with the context of the original email
premises.evidence_span: she thinks it'd be extra awesome if she could move these files directly into other cloud services and keep them associated with the context of the original email.

premises.text: Cloudless saves space and keeps files organized by replacing email attachments with links to view and download from cloud services
premises.evidence_span: Cloudless instantaneously replaces the file with links to still view and download it.

premises.text: Cloudless can automate the organization of files based on email content
premises.evidence_span: Liz tells Cloudless to automatically send everything that she's receiving from this big enterprise company directly into the correct contract folder.

premises.text: Cloudless provides secure sharing of files with access control permissions
premises.evidence_span: Cloudless limits access to this file to just the designated recipients, making sure that the file is being securely shared.

premises.text: Cloudless allows users to set policies across cloud applications for consistent data handling
premises.evidence_span: she sets policies across the cloud applications that they use so that she can make sure that data is being consistently handled.

premises.text: Cloudless provides visibility into data ownership and workflow across teams
premises.evidence_span: Using the event-based notification dashboard that Cloudless has, Liz gains visibility into who owns what data and what the data workflow is around her entire organization.

premises.text: Cloudless aims to create a secure, connected enterprise cloud and control data workflow across applications
premises.evidence_span: Our mission is to create a secure, connected enterprise cloud and control the data workflow across many applications.

premises.text: Cloudless can capture a significant portion of the data governance market by appealing to individual users and functional business units
premises.evidence_span: Cloudless can capture $2 billion of the $77 billion data governance market by appealing directly to individual users and functional business units.

value.text: Cloudless offers a simple, secure workflow across the enterprise cloud that users and IT will love
value.evidence_span: Cloudless offers a simple, secure workflow across the enterprise cloud that users and IT will love.
